effect: Floating and managed exchange rates drift on the change in the current account since the start, not on its level: the drift term uses caPct - caPct0, where caPct0 is the currency's current-account share the first time it is priced, stored on the sovereign record of the currency's anchor country at that time (sovereign.geobalCaPct0[code]) and found there afterwards whichever member anchors the currency later (a union whose largest member changes keeps its baseline; the save keeps only a fixed list of currency fields, so the currency itself cannot hold it). Structural day-0 surpluses (Switzerland) and deficits (US, UK) no longer push the currency forever; changes after day 0 still move it as before. Day 0 unchanged (no pricing has run); pegs and boards unaffected. (Minified names in this text are those of build 26296134; the patch's find text has the current ones.)
